text: Program Description Program Introduction The Chemical Engineering Discipline of China University of Petroleum-Beijing (CUPB) is one of the best in petroleum refining in China. Chemical Engineering and Technology applies basic sciences, methods and technologies to the effective processing and upgrading of crude oil, residues, distillates and gaseous products. Courses you'll take Petroleum Chemistry Catalytic chemistry Chemical Reaction Engineering Advanced Instrumental Analysis Research Areas Oil Field Chemistry and Engineering Petroleum and Natural Gas Chemistry Oil and Gas Processing Technics and Engineering New Materials and Catalyst Engineering Biological and Environmental Chemical Engineering New Energy Chemical Engineering Process Reinforcement and Equipment Intelligent Chemical Engineering and Technology
